definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese bedding consisting of a mattress and quilt that can be folded and stored during the day.

examples.japanese: {布団|ふとん}を{敷|し}いてください。
{朝|あさ}{布団|ふとん}を{畳|たた}みます。
examples.english: I fold the futon in the morning.

notes:
{布団|ふとん} consists of a mattress ({敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}) and a quilt ({掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}).

TYPES OF FUTON:
- {敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}: mattress (bottom)
- {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}: comforter (top)
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket
- {枕|まくら}: pillow

COMMON VERBS:
- {布団|ふとん}を{敷|し}く: to lay out the futon
- {布団|ふとん}を{畳|たた}む: to fold the futon
- {布団|ふとん}を{干|ほ}す: to air out the futon
- {布団|ふとん}に{入|はい}る: to get into bed

CULTURAL NOTE: Japanese futons are stored in closets ({押|お}し{入|い}れ) during the day to save space.
